# High-Contrast Accessible Dark Theme

An institutional-grade accessibility theme for OpenOptOut engineered to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AAA requirements.

## Accessibility Highlights

| Standard | Measured Value | Requirement | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Text Contrast (`#ffffff` on `#000000`) | 21.0:1 | 7.0:1 (WCAG AAA) | Exceeds |
| Accent/Focus Contrast (`#ffff00` on `#000000`) | 19.5:1 | 7.0:1 (WCAG AAA) | Exceeds |
| Component Borders (`#ffff00` on `#000000`) | 19.5:1 | 4.5:1 (WCAG AAA) | Exceeds |
| Secondary Text (`#e0e0e0` on `#000000`) | 14.8:1 | 7.0:1 (WCAG AAA) | Exceeds |
| Focus Indicator Outline | 3px solid | Minimum 2px | Compliant |
| Reduced Motion Support | Supported | Instant transition | Compliant |

## Installation

Place this directory in `<plugins_root>/themes/theme-high-contrast-aaa/` or install via the OpenOptOut Community Market.
